title: Deploy: Forge/Docker, zero-downtime, migrations in prod

preview.what: Deploying Laravel: Docker/Forge, zero-downtime, running migrations in production safely.
preview.picture: Changing the tires while the car is moving: build the new version beside the old one, switch the symlink, never lock a big table at noon.
preview.why: 'How do you deploy a schema change without downtime?' is a favourite.
preview.bn: চলন্ত গাড়ির চাকা বদলানো: নতুন version পাশে বানাও, symlink ঘোরাও, দুপুরে বড় table lock করো না।
